title: Myeongdong guide: K-beauty, shopping, food & sights
desc: Myeongdong in Seoul, grouped into shopping and K-beauty, food, and sights and shows.

items.title: Lotte Department Store Main (롯데백화점 본점)
items.memo: Flagship department store with supermarket, food court and duty-free; known from K-dramas.

items.title: Shinsegae Main Store (신세계백화점 본점)
items.memo: Quieter flagship with a strong food hall and luxury brands.

items.title: Olive Young Myeongdong (올리브영 명동)
items.memo: Large Olive Young flagship with a wide range of Korean beauty brands; fewer testers than smaller stores.

items.title: 3CE Pink Space Hotel (Stylenanda)
items.memo: Pink hotel-themed store for trendy makeup and clothes; very photogenic.

items.title: Noon Square (눈스퀘어)
items.memo: Mall with affordable international fashion brands.

items.title: Myeongdong Kyoja (명동교자)
items.memo: Michelin-listed noodle house; try the kalguksu. The cold noodles are very spicy.

items.title: Hadongkwan (하동관)
items.memo: Gomtang (beef bone soup) since 1939; closes mid-afternoon, so go early.

items.title: Myeongdong Cathedral (명동성당)
items.memo: Gothic cathedral from 1898; English Mass on Sundays, lit up at Christmas.

items.title: Namsangol Hanok Village (남산골한옥마을)
items.memo: Traditional hanok village a short trip from Myeongdong.
